lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: I was charged twice for the same payment on my card and I want this fixed now. This is completely unacceptable.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: It is seven seven four zero. I have been a customer for years and this is the worst service I have ever had.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: That is not true, my bank statement shows two payments. I want to speak to your manager.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: I can raise a ticket with the payments team. They will look at it within seven days.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Seven days? That is ridiculous. I am going to file a complaint.
